by_cases hc:d=b
    · subst b
      have hA : Own A d false := by simpa [spar] using hA d
      have hD : w d= -100 := chart_there ..
      let z := fun n => coneWeight d (fuel (-99) n) (homes w n)
      obtain ⟨hm,hs⟩ := mass V H J P hP hi hr C d A he hA (hg d) (fun i => 1+w i) (-99) (by norm_num)
        (fun i _ => by linarith [(hk i).2]) _ hG 1 (by norm_num)
      obtain ⟨M,hM,hN⟩ := bead_size w d f e hj hf (-3000) (-99) (by linarith)
      obtain ⟨N,hL,hO⟩ := mote_size w d f e hj hf (-3000)
      let Y n := cave d (-3000) n
      have hF : Budget (-101) (fun n => cross (V d) B A ((Y n).indicator (X n))) :=
        (balanced_mul (V d) B A _ (hX.mono fun n hn i => (hn i).indicator (cave_m ..)) u (1+(-99)*4) T z hY hm hT hs 3 M hM (fun n p H => ⟨due_nn _ _ _ _ p H,cone_nn _ _ _ (home_lit w n) p (fuel_pos ..) H,hN n p H⟩)).rise (by linarith)
      let U := due w d 0
      have hS := normal w d V A 300 (fun i => by linarith [(hk i).1])
      have hB : Budget (-101) (fun n => cross (V d) B A ((Y n)ᶜ.indicator (X n))) :=
        (balanced_mul (V d) B A _ (hX.mono fun n hn i => (hn i).indicator (cave_m .. |>.compl)) u (300*3) T U hY
          (fun n => cost_int V d A _ (fuel_pos ..) _ _) hT hS (3+(-3000)/2) N hL (fun n p H => ⟨due_nn _ _ _ _ p H,due_nn _ _ _ _ p H,hO n p H⟩)).rise (by linarith)
      exact (hF.add hB).same (hX.mono fun n hn => partition_cross _ _ _ (X n) hn _ (cave_m ..))

proof_context.conclusion: For `d=b` the integral is split with `cave d (-3000)` and its complement (`partition_cross`); `mass` with exponent `-99` and `balanced_mul` bound the near part, and `mote_size` with `300*3` the far part, each by `Budget (-101)`.

obtain ⟨hA,hB⟩ := drained x hx q J P H hp hi h.tensor h.symmetric a b l hh ht
  obtain ⟨hY,hZ⟩ := drained x hx q J P H hp hi h.tensor h.symmetric b a l (Ne.symm hh) ht
  let K := Ortho.plane b a
  have he : Budget (-1) (fun _ => localTurn p Y K q x) := by
    refine ((hB.sub hZ).neg).same ?_
    filter_upwards [hA,hY,eventually_all.mpr fun i => eventually_all.mpr fun j => vane_home (x j) a b l i hh] with n hon hin hs
    rw [flux_value P H hp J p Y h K x hx q (vane a b l n) (vane_s a b l n) (vane_k a b l n) hs]
    simp_rw [draught_river x q J h.tensor.symmetric a b l hh n]; rw [integral_sub hon hin]
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique tendsto_const_nhds (he.limits (by norm_num))

proof_context.conclusion: The `V_a` terms come from `drained` with `a,b` exchanged, and `tendsto_nhds_unique` forces the `λ`-independent value to vanish from the `Budget (-1)` bound.

lemma fullTurn (P : DiffPlan S) (H : S.Hierarchy) (hp : P.Derivatives S) (hi : P.Orientation H.spin) (J : Stress S)
    (p : Parts S) (Y : SpinRows S) (h : Pre H P J p Y) (x : Points m) (hx : x∈conf _) (q : Fin m → S.Tag) (l : Axis) (ht : onLine l x) (K : Ortho.Skew) :
    localTurn p Y K q x=0 := by
  cases m with
  | zero => simp [localTurn]
  | succ m =>
    obtain ⟨U,hU⟩ := swirlLinear p Y q x
    have he : U=0 := by
      refine Spin.extendsE _ _ fun i => ?_
      obtain ⟨b,a⟩ := i
      by_cases hf:a=b
      · subst b; rw [show Spin.K (a,a)=0 from Subtype.ext (by simp [Spin.K,Ortho.plane]),map_zero,LinearMap.zero_apply]
      rw [← hU]; exact axisTurn x hx q J P H hp hi p Y h a b l hf ht
    rw [hU,he,LinearMap.zero_apply]

proof_context.conclusion: Linearity in `K` extends the vanishing from the planes to every `K`.
